text:
Walker announces 2026-27 skating and hockey lesson registration details
The City of Walker announced on Aug. 5 that online registration for session 1 of the 2026-27 skating and hockey season will open on July 15 at 6 p.m. The first session is scheduled to run from September 19 through October 31, with classes held Saturday mornings at 10 a.m. The seven-week program costs $126, and interested participants can sign up via the city's online registration portal.
The city said that Learn to Skate, Snowplow, and Learn to Play Hockey classes do not accommodate friend requests. Skaters are placed in groups based on experience level, which may result in movement between groups during the session. There are no make-up sessions offered for missed classes.
For questions about the programs, residents are encouraged to contact Mike Fountain, Gillian Hendershot, or Shea McGee-Sarns or call (616) 735-6286 and ask for Gillian or Mike.
According to the city, Learn to Skate, Learn to Play Hockey, and Snowplow are city-run programs designed for all ages who wish to begin or develop their skating or hockey skills in a group setting. More information about class components is available on the city's program overview page.
Adult lessons are also available as part of these offerings. The adult class is intended for individuals aged sixteen and older who are new to ice skating or want to improve their abilities.
